queue_investigation.conclusion: The original job remains eligible and unclaimed. Root cause is unconfirmed after 74 successful diagnostic repetitions. The extended campaign also hit a separate global harness timeout after 34 successes; an explicitly bounded final ten-repetition batch passed. No runtime code or eight-second assertion was changed.

diagnostic_repetitions.explanation: The planned 50 repetitions exceeded Go’s default ten-minute global test timeout; the interrupted 35th repetition was three seconds into producer setup, before starting a worker. This did not reproduce the original eight-second job deadline.

security.proof: Inspect scanner findings and npm audit output, including module-only findings and existing tool identities.

starter.proof: Source baseline unchanged in real starter; apply reviewed handwritten migration to disposable copy, pin runtime/tool together, regenerate Go/manifest/OpenAPI/TS, require real integrations on macOS and Linux arm64.
